setup_registry: create a new registry with setup_registry to register and build classes by name using argparse args
register_x: register a class with the register_x decorator returned by setup_registry under a unique name
build_x: build an instance from the registry using build_x with an argparse Namespace and the registered choice
set_defaults: set default arguments on an argparse Namespace from a class add_args method using set_defaults
review_setup_registry: review the setup_registry function to understand how it creates build and register closures for a named registry
